status: local-candidate; no hosted admission or live acceptance claimed

baseEvidence.locator: line 1 BASE_URL; official documentation links the demo

authentication.destination: key HTTP header on api.os.uk only
authentication.discrepancy: Embedded operation OpenAPI declares query key only; shared official authentication page expressly permits header key. Header implementation still requires a successful bounded runtime receipt.

methods.meaning: UPRN to closest associated RoadLink according to the published method.
methods.limits: Includes live, provisional and historic BLPU; do not label it verified vehicle/pedestrian access or serving-road topology. Source cycles differ.

methods.meaning: Addressable location to its recorded Street relationships.
methods.limits: Includes live, provisional and historic BLPU and open roads in the described extraction; no geometry or postal-address attributes returned.

methods.meaning: Addressable-location UPRN to corresponding topographic polygon; building examples are supported.
methods.limits: Includes live, provisional and historic BLPU records; not every UPRN denotes a building and current NGD Building geometry is not established as equivalent. Source cycles differ.

methods.meaning: Corresponding Highways and generalised Open Roads link representations.
methods.limits: Different refresh cycles and geometry capture mean no automatic shape or attribute equivalence.

methods.meaning: A Highways RoadLink simplified to an Open Roads node, for example a collapsed roundabout.
methods.limits: ORRoadNode GUID is explicitly non-persistent; this link changes representation dimension and cannot preserve route topology/geometry.

methods.meaning: RoadLink membership in a Road link set sharing a name or classification.
methods.limits: Same-source version agreement is described for extraction, not a timeless match to later geometry.

methods.meaning: RoadLink membership in a matched Street.
methods.limits: USRNs without matched RoadLinks are omitted. Same-source extraction does not establish current edition compatibility.

methods.meaning: Road centre line to corresponding road surface polygons. Does not establish a building footprint relationship.
methods.limits: Not every RoadLink has a corresponding TopographicArea; different source refresh cycles can invalidate version alignment.

methods.meaning: Road–Street association through common component RoadLinks.
methods.limits: Shared-component association does not make Road and Street identical; extraction uses one source product.

methods.meaning: A named or classified Road is a collection of RoadLinks; targets are road surface polygons.
methods.limits: Source cycles differ; no direct building link and no universal one-to-one correspondence.

methods.meaning: Street to road surfaces through its matched RoadLinks.
methods.limits: Street USRNs without a matched OS RoadLink are omitted; source cycles differ.

responseScope.genericIdentifier: linkedIdentifiers array; UPRN and USRN numeric namespaces can overlap, so one ID can yield multiple typed results.
responseScope.typedLookup: linkedIdentifier object plus correlations array; each correlation has correlatedIdentifiers array.
responseScope.versions: Optional searchedIdentifierVersionDate/Number and correlated versionDate/Number are strings/numbers in the contract, not a proven ISO lexical/date-time model.
responseScope.paging: No paging/filter/query parameters, continuation links or numeric result maximum documented in these four contracts. Complete transport/JSON parsing is necessary; do not infer national or universal relationship completeness.

deadline: Immutable selection requires an absolute UTC deadline; every request is bounded by its remaining time.
resume: Successful responses and observations are independently replayed by checksum. Any failed or pending attempt stops automatic continuation. Reserved uncertain bytes and time are not refunded.

sourceDefects.handling: Resolve only from separately captured official demo BASE_URL; do not interpolate arbitrary hosts.

sourceDefects.defect: correlationMethodInformation requires methodIdentfier but declares methodIdentifier with additionalProperties:false.
sourceDefects.handling: Preserve exact source defect; use explicit reviewed validator policy, flag unexpected spelling/runtime shape.

sourceDefects.defect: correlatedIdentifiers puts required/additionalProperties on array rather than the item schema.
sourceDefects.handling: Do not claim schema conformance from a mechanical validator; enforce reviewed item semantics and distinguish missing values.

sourceDefects.defect: Download JSON page differs from API productVersionInfo fields/casing and omits Open Roads feature types in its list.
sourceDefects.handling: Do not substitute download contract for API response; keep separate sources.

sourceDefects.defect: Overview advertises GeoJSON while operations declare application/json relationship objects.
sourceDefects.handling: Use operation response contract; no geometry inference.

coverageExclusions: GSS codes and LocalAuthority/MSOA/LSOA/OA are not supported identifier/feature enums.
OSID, NGD Building and PathLink are not supported identifier/feature enums.
GB coverage does not establish Northern Ireland applicability.
No geometry, heights, address text, access topology or complete property/road population supplied.
No API historical as-of/version selector is documented. productVersionInfo returns current valid source version information.
semantics: Confidence describes source version alignment, not probability or positional accuracy.
Methods 5, 9 and 11 include live, provisional and historic BLPU.
Typed nodes keep identifier and feature namespaces distinct; preserve each observed edge direction and native versions.
No inverse edge, transitive identity, field equivalence, geometry equivalence, access topology or current containment is inferred.
A completed selected response does not establish nationwide relationship completeness.
